slice: D2 - outdoor, garden, pets and cars

ideas.name: Nordic Bird-Safe Window Kit
ideas.concept: Pre-spaced outdoor-applied UV/frosted-pattern decal sheets with a printed 5 cm grid template and squeegee, sold as seasonal refill packs.
ideas.target_customer: Villa and apartment owners with large glazing and garden bird lovers in SE/DK.
ideas.problem_solved: Owners know one or two stickers do not work; they need dense, correctly spaced, exterior-rated coverage and no guesswork.
ideas.trend_evidence: Sources agree sparse stickers fail and spacing under 5 cm on the outside is needed. No EU sales or search-trend data found; demand is unverified and sources are partly retailers.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Daylight/window expertise: pattern designed to preserve view and daylight, template-guided install, own design and brand; replacement packs create repeat purchase.

ideas.name: Balcony Bokashi Finisher Refills
ideas.concept: Branded bokashi bran plus a balcony-planter burial kit solving the 'where does the fermented output go' gap.
ideas.target_customer: Apartment dwellers in Stockholm/Copenhagen who sort food waste.
ideas.problem_solved: Bokashi yields pre-compost that must be buried; apartment users lack soil, and bran is a recurring cost.
ideas.trend_evidence: Guides state apartment bokashi's main drawback is output disposal and bran is a monthly cost; a Swedish retailer sells a Swedish-made bokashi bin. No Nordic demand data found, so trend unverified.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Own bran blend and bundle with finishing planter liner; subscription refill. Needs check on EU fertiliser/organic-product rules and sourcing of microbial bran.
ideas.tooling_needed: None (bagged bran, printed pouch, fabric liner).

ideas.name: Hallway Dog Dry Station (Nordic design)
ideas.concept: Design-led entryway set: wall-hung quick-dry towel with hand pockets plus absorbent runner in matching textiles, aimed at interiors-conscious owners rather than generic pet shops.
ideas.target_customer: Urban and suburban dog owners in rainy, muddy Nordic seasons.
ideas.problem_solved: Wet and muddy dogs after walks, drips and floor marks, skin problems from skipping drying.
ideas.trend_evidence: Many vendors push drying mats and towels and the Amazon category is crowded; owner reviews cited are promotional. This is a flooded category, so only a design/brand angle could work.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Weak: only design language, colourways and sizing for Nordic hallways; OEKO-TEX textiles. Treat as fallback.
ideas.tooling_needed: None (cut and sew textiles, private-label fabric).

ideas.name: Rural Biothane Long Line + Safety Swivel Kit
ideas.concept: Heavy-duty, odour-free biothane 5/10 m long lines with rated swivel clip and reflective stitching, tested and load-rated for strong dogs that cannot go off-leash.
ideas.target_customer: Owners of strong or recall-challenged dogs living rurally or in forests in SE/DK.
ideas.problem_solved: Owners ask for heavy-duty leash and harness options for dogs that run off; generic nylon lines fail, tangle or stink when wet.
ideas.trend_evidence: One r/dogs thread (archived snapshot) asks for heavy-duty leash/harness options for a runaway-prone German Shepherd mix; single anecdote only, no trend data.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Published load testing and Nordic-dark reflective spec, brand and community; hardware sourcing exclusivity. Biothane lines already exist, so differentiation is spec and trust.
ideas.tooling_needed: None (off-the-shelf hardware, cut and stitched webbing).

ideas.name: Winter Mirror and Glass Clear Kit
ideas.concept: Compact kit: wide flexible mirror scraper, soft-edge windshield blade and de-icing cloth in a magnetic pouch, aimed at the frosted side-mirror annoyance.
ideas.target_customer: Commuting drivers in SE/DK new to or tired of winter scraping.
ideas.problem_solved: Scraping side mirrors and glass by hand or with a credit card; ice scrapers are bulky and scratch.
ideas.trend_evidence: A Reddit-linked list of car features that should be standard cites frosted side mirrors and card-scraping; Skoda's hidden scraper drew comment. Anecdotal only, category dominated by cheap generics, so near-kill risk on price and private label.
ideas.defensibility_angle: Weak; only bundle design and brand. Included mainly to show a rejected-leaning option.
ideas.tooling_needed: Possible small mould for scraper blade; avoid by using stock blades with custom print.
